title: Solar Panel Installation Technician
description: Installs, tests, and maintains rooftop and ground-mounted solar photovoltaic systems in accordance with electrical and safety codes.

competencies.title: Site Inspection & Solar Panel Mounting Structure Setup
competencies.description: Assess site tilt angle, shading, roof integrity, and assemble panel mounting structures safely.

criteria.description: Inspect roof structure integrity and measure solar azimuth and tilt angles accurately using shadow tools.

rubric_definitions_json.0: Fails to inspect roof or measure angles correctly.
rubric_definitions_json.5: Measures basic angles but omits shading analysis.
rubric_definitions_json.10: Accurately measures tilt/azimuth and assesses roof integrity.

criteria.description: Anchor mounting racks using weather-resistant fasteners with proper torque.

rubric_definitions_json.5: Secures frame but misses torque specifications.
rubric_definitions_json.10: Flawlessly secures frames with proper torque and weatherproofing.

criteria.description: Use personal protective equipment (PPE) including safety harness while working at height.

rubric_definitions_json.0: Fails to wear safety harness at height (SAFETY CRITICAL VIOLATION).
rubric_definitions_json.5: Wears harness loosely or late in the task.
rubric_definitions_json.10: Strictly adheres to height safety PPE protocol throughout.

competencies.title: DC Electrical Wiring & Inverter Connection
competencies.description: Connect solar modules in string series/parallel, wire DC disconnects, and connect to grid-tied/off-grid inverters.

criteria.description: Wire PV module junction boxes using correct MC4 connectors and polarity checks.

rubric_definitions_json.0: Reverse polarity connection or exposed bare wire.
rubric_definitions_json.5: Correct polarity but loose crimps on MC4 connectors.
rubric_definitions_json.10: Perfect polarity verification, clean crimping, and insulation.

criteria.description: Install surge protection devices (SPD) and earthing ground pits.

rubric_definitions_json.0: No earthing pit connected or SPD omitted.
rubric_definitions_json.5: Earthing connected but resistance not measured.
rubric_definitions_json.10: SPD installed and earth pit resistance verified under 5 ohms.

title: Mason Tiling
description: Lays ceramic, vitrified, and stone tiles on floors and walls with precise plumb, alignment, level, and grouting.

competencies.title: Surface Preparation & Mortar Bedding
competencies.description: Prepare screed surface, clean dust, mix tile adhesive / mortar to required consistency.

criteria.description: Clean surface substrate and check floor slope using spirit level.

rubric_definitions_json.0: Lays mortar over dusty, un-level substrate.
rubric_definitions_json.5: Cleans substrate but slope check is imprecise.
rubric_definitions_json.10: Thorough substrate prep and exact spirit level slope verification.

criteria.description: Mix polymer-modified adhesive mortar to lump-free consistency.

rubric_definitions_json.5: Acceptable mix but works past pot life.
rubric_definitions_json.10: Homogeneous lump-free mix adhering to specified water ratio.

competencies.title: Tile Laying, Alignment & Grouting
competencies.description: Cut tiles, position with spacers, tap into place, check lip page, apply epoxy grout.

criteria.description: Cut vitrified tiles cleanly using manual tile cutter without edge chipping.

rubric_definitions_json.0: Severe edge cracking or broken tiles.
rubric_definitions_json.10: Clean straight cut with zero edge chipping.

criteria.description: Maintain 2mm uniform grout joints using spacers and verify zero lippage.

rubric_definitions_json.0: Uneven joint width and noticeable height lippage.
rubric_definitions_json.5: Uniform joints but minor lippage detected.
rubric_definitions_json.10: Impeccable spacing and perfectly flush surface.

criteria.description: Wear safety goggles and gloves while operating electrical tile cutter.

rubric_definitions_json.0: Operates power cutter without eye protection (SAFETY CRITICAL).
rubric_definitions_json.10: Full eye and hand protection used continuously.

title: Automotive Electrician
description: Diagnoses, repairs, and rewires electrical components, alternators, starters, ignition, and battery management systems in motor vehicles.

competencies.title: Vehicle Electrical System Diagnosis
competencies.description: Use digital multimeter, OBD-II scanner, and wiring schematics to locate short circuits, blown fuses, and voltage drops.

criteria.description: Read wiring circuit diagrams and correctly measure DC voltage and continuity across relays.

rubric_definitions_json.0: Cannot read schematic or sets multimeter to wrong scale.
rubric_definitions_json.5: Reads basic schematic but takes flawed voltage drop readings.
rubric_definitions_json.10: Accurately interprets schematic and isolates open/short fault.

criteria.description: Disconnect battery negative terminal prior to working on starter/alternator high-current wiring.

rubric_definitions_json.0: Fails to disconnect battery negative before high-current work (SAFETY CRITICAL SHORT RISK).
rubric_definitions_json.10: Strictly isolates negative terminal prior to repair.

title: Domestic Data Entry Operator
description: Maintains database records, enters textual and numerical data accurately, formats documents, and enforces data privacy.

competencies.title: Data Entry Operation & Accuracy Verification
competencies.description: Operate keyboard efficiently, enter tabular records in spreadsheet, verify data integrity, format outputs.

criteria.description: Demonstrate touch typing speed of at least 35 WPM with 95% accuracy.
Perform data validation, formula calculations (SUM, AVERAGE, VLOOKUP) in spreadsheet.

rubric_definitions_json.0: Unable to write basic spreadsheet formulas.
rubric_definitions_json.5: Uses basic SUM but fails complex lookup formulas.
rubric_definitions_json.10: Correctly applies formulas, sorting, and data validation rules.

title: Welder - Structural
description: Performs Shielded Metal Arc Welding (SMAW) and MIG welding on carbon steel plates and structural shapes in 1G, 2G, 3G positions.

competencies.title: SMAW / MIG Welding Operation & Bead Quality
competencies.description: Prepare joint edges, set welding current/voltage, strike arc, deposit uniform bead, inspect for undercut/porosity.

criteria.description: Set arc welding current appropriately according to electrode diameter (e.g. E6013, 3.15mm).

rubric_definitions_json.0: Incorrect current causing electrode sticking or burn-through.
rubric_definitions_json.10: Optimal current setting resulting in smooth arc stability.

criteria.description: Deposit uniform weld bead without slag inclusion, undercut, or excessive porosity.

rubric_definitions_json.0: Heavy slag inclusions or severe weld cracking.
rubric_definitions_json.5: Sound weld but slight uneven ripples.
rubric_definitions_json.10: Flawless bead geometry, full penetration, zero surface defects.

criteria.description: Use auto-darkening welding helmet, leather apron, and welding gloves; ensure fume extraction.

rubric_definitions_json.0: Strikes arc without welding helmet (SAFETY CRITICAL FLASH RISK).
rubric_definitions_json.5: Uses helmet but lacks leather sleeve protection.
rubric_definitions_json.10: Full protective clothing and eye shade used continuously.
